mapper.sql: id, student_id, course_id, slot_id, lesson_date, status, absent_by, absent_reason, make_up_date, closed, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT l.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.name AS studentName, CONCAT(ts.start_time, '-', ts.end_time) AS slot, l.status AS status, l.absent_by AS absentBy, l.absent_reason AS absentReason FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON l.slot_id = ts.id WHERE YEAR(l.lesson_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(l.lesson_date) = #{month} AND l.status IN ('ABSENT', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY l.lesson_date, l.slot_id
